title: Transparency
lead: How the campaign books are kept. A public ledger of figures is not published yet.
method: Gifts are recorded after they are reconciled against the bank statement. Individual amounts and the names of those who gave are not published.
Invoices and receipts for the work are kept in an internal file. They are not published because they often hold third-party data.
This page does not show totals or a ledger of expenses. When that accounting is published, it will be here, with its date.
